With `position: absolute` and no `top/left/right/bottom` specified, the element’s inset values default to `auto`, so Chromium places it at its “static position” (the position it would have had in normal document flow). In the rendered tree, the preceding `spacer` occupies `height: 50px`, and `floaty` appears immediately after it in the flow. Therefore, `floaty`’s top edge renders at **y = 50px**.
